title: Interactive Navigation Beyond Reachability: Benchmark and Agentic Framework
abstract: arXiv:2610.17089v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Existing embodied navigation tasks commonly assume that traversability and object states remain fixed during an episode. Yet reaching a goal may require opening a door to access a room and then opening a container to reveal a hidden target. We formulate interactive navigation beyond reachability, unifying channel-induced changes in spatial connectivity, container-induced changes in target visibility, and their sequential dependencies. We introduce MultINav-Bench, a 3K-episode ObjectGoal benchmark in MolmoSpaces spanning channel, container, and mixed tasks, with interaction-necessity annotations covering required and unnecessary episodes. Its data generation pipeline automates task construction across multiple task types. The evaluation protocol separately measures navigation success, interaction effectiveness, and cost. translated_title: 超越可达性的交互式导航：基准测试与智能体框架
translated_abstract: 现有的具身导航任务通常假设在一次任务回合中，可通行性和物体状态保持不变。然而，到达目标可能需要先打开一扇门以进入房间，再打开一个容器以显现隐藏的目标。我们提出了“超越可达性的交互式导航”这一问题，统一了由通道引起的空间连通性变化、由容器引起的目标可见性变化，以及二者的先后依赖关系。我们介绍了MultINav-Bench，这是一个构建于MolmoSpaces之上、包含3千个回合的ObjectGoal基准测试，涵盖通道、容器和混合任务，并带有交互必要性标注（包含需要交互和不必要交互的回合）。其数据生成流程可自动构建多种任务类型。评估协议分别测量导航成功率、交互有效性和交互成本。我们进一步提出了MultINav-Agent，这是一个基于持久性、状态条件化交互机制（摘要在此处被截断）的三阶段智能体框架。
tldr: 该论文提出“超越可达性的交互式导航”新问题，统一了开门改变空间连通性与开容器改变目标可见性这两类交互及其顺序依赖，并构建了含3千回合的MultINav-Bench基准与三阶段智能体框架MultINav-Agent。
en_tdlr: The paper formulates interactive navigation beyond reachability—unifying channel-induced changes in spatial connectivity, container-induced changes in target visibility, and their sequential dependencies—and introduces MultINav-Bench, a 3K-episode ObjectGoal benchmark, along with MultINav-Agent, a three-stage agentic framework.
